titulo.estudio: Confronter plusieurs sources : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Cross-checking several sources: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Summarise the points in common and the differences between three documents with different scopes. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Summarise the points in common and the differences between three documents with different scopes. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: check authorship, date, population and method before comparing figures or inferring a trend. In this passage, «sondage» means «poll».

frases.estudio: Un sondage national, publié la même semaine, indique une progression de 11 % sur l'année entière.
frases.alumno: A national poll, published the same week, shows an 11% increase over the whole year.

frases.estudio: Un collectif local conteste la comparaison, car le nouveau comptage ne couvre que les axes réaménagés.
frases.alumno: A local group challenges the comparison, because the new count only covers the roads that have been remodelled.
